core_journeys.required_outcome: Patient asks a records question in fewer decisions than current state.
peak_decisions: Review sourced answer with consent provenance
core_journeys.prototype_evidence: Figma live verification on 2026-08-12: Web Patient sidebar Records cards now provide visible entry to web/patient/records from patient frames; Mobile Patient Records tabs now provide visible entry to mobile/patient/records. Both records frames include Ask question reactions and sourced answer/PHI provenance states.

core_journeys.required_outcome: Staff triages an incident and reviews a summary in fewer decisions than current state.
core_journeys.prototype_evidence: Figma live verification on 2026-08-12: Web Hospital chains Home Triage incident -> web/hospital/incidents -> Review patient summary -> web/hospital/summary -> Trace audit -> web/hospital/audit; Home Review summary also routes directly to summary. Mobile Hospital chains Home Triage alert -> mobile/hospital/alerts -> Trace audit -> mobile/hospital/audit; Home Review summary routes to summary and summary Open audit trail routes to audit.

accessibility_evidence.touch_targets: Peak UX component guidance specifies 44px/44pt minimum targets. Figma button frames are visually sized above 44px/44pt in the main flows.
accessibility_evidence.focus_order: Goal, Foundations, Components, and Rationale pages document focus order requirements; primary journeys are ordered visually top-to-bottom and left-to-right.
accessibility_evidence.reduced_motion: Peak UX DNA and Goal evidence document reduced-motion behavior for Premium patient and Corporate hospital motion patterns.
accessibility_evidence.phi_annotations: PHI-sensitive cards and regions are marked in patient records, consent, summary provenance, and audit surfaces.

figma_text_contrast_scan.method: Figma MCP approximate scan of visible TEXT solid foreground against nearest solid ancestor background; normal text threshold 4.5:1, large text threshold 3:1.
figma_text_contrast_scan.scope_note: This supports contrast evidence only; full WCAG 2.2 AA still requires keyboard, focus, touch-target, reduced-motion, and screen-reader checks.

target_size_scan.method: Figma MCP scan of visible nodes with prototype reactions across core Peak UX pages. WCAG 2.2 AA target-size threshold recorded as 24x24; project mobile comfort threshold recorded as 44x44.
target_size_scan.patch: Raised 45 Mobile Patient bottom tab instances from 62x39 to 62x45 by increasing existing top/bottom tab padding from 7 to 10.
target_size_scan.scope_note: Target size evidence does not prove full WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, touch semantics, and screen-reader labels remain separate gates.

interactive_name_focus_metadata.scope_note: Design-time metadata supports prototype accessibility handoff; runtime screen-reader and keyboard testing remain open.

web_build_a11y_warning_fix.evidence: Next.js production build completed successfully after adding aria-selected to PatientPicker role="option" results; the previous jsx-a11y role-has-required-aria-props warning did not recur.
web_build_a11y_warning_fix.scope_note: This proves the specific PatientPicker build-time accessibility warning is fixed; it is not a full runtime keyboard or screen-reader audit.
